svg.title: Talweir: the city between Namar and Iren
svg.desc: Nine overlapping district envelopes and twenty-four authored places in a north-up azimuthal equidistant city plan. Whole-lake inset preserves atlas projection. Water heights and channel shapes are planning controls, not terrain or a hydraulic model.
svg.text: TALWEIR / THE CITY BETWEEN TWO LAKES
CITY-005 · 742 AL · Working plan 0.1 · 780,000 residents, authored estimate
North is up · coordinates in kilometers · z is planning sea-level altitude · envelopes overlap; no surveyed terrain or service capacity
Cream labels: places · dark labels: district envelopes · dotted lines: tram dependencies, not route alignments
Namar outlet 180 m → Talweir junction 179.7 m → Iren inlet 176 m
Navigation cut: 179.6 → 177.8 → 176 m, two 1.8 m locks · flowing bypass remains separate
The 4 m total head does not establish flow, useful power, vessel clearance, lock throughput or pipe pressure.
08 and 18 are supported overwater decks; 16 marks Trial Pond, with a separate dry visitor-access control.
Ferry interchanges are on land. Access legs, actual berths, streets, structures and navigable alignments remain to be designed.
Source: talweir_city_plan.json · AEQD from 28° N, 124° E, radius 5,900 km · authored controls, not constructed terrain.
